stem: Find the line passing through the point $(-4, 5)$ and parallel to the $x$-axis. Drag the two points so the line is that line.
solution: A line parallel to the $x$-axis is horizontal: all its points share one $y$-value.

hints.text: A line parallel to the x-axis runs left to right, not up and down.
Every point on the line has the y-value of the given point. Check where your line meets the y-axis.
Decide the gradient of a line parallel to the x-axis first.
